quote: PoT aims to prompt Code Large Language Models (Code LLMs) to decompose complex problems into successive executable codes.
Program of Thoughts (PoT) aims to prompt Code Large Language Models (Code LLMs) to decompose complex problems into successive executable codes.
outputs: The generated outputs are executable code programs in multiple programming languages that solve reasoning tasks, with final answers extracted via execution.

quote: Remaining consistent with previous work, the metric is accuracy. For tasks whose ground truth are real numbers (Appl./Math), the answer is considered correct if its difference from the ground truth is less than 1e-3; for tasks with string-type ground truth (Date/Tabular/Spatial), the answer is considered correct only if it is exactly the same as the ground truth.
